item.title: Popular seven-seat Peugeot 5008 continues to see an increase in sales figures across Ireland
item.description: Peugeot Ireland is celebrating as the Peugeot 5008 is now Ireland’s best-selling large SUV. With sales surging 38% year-on-year, the 5008 continues to resonate with Irish families seeking the perfect combination of space, safety, and style, now with the added benefit of an electrified powertrain. item.title: Council confirms that social and affordable scheme will break ground by Christmas
